reason: A Feishu/Lark integration that provides bidirectional chat with a locally running DeepSeek Harness agent, including session mapping, streamed replies, approval and question forwarding, and reconnect handling.

summaries.zh: 通过飞书长连接将私聊或群聊消息双向桥接到本地运行的 DeepSeek Harness Agent，并转发回复、审批请求和提问。
summaries.en: Bridges Feishu/Lark conversations with a locally running DeepSeek Harness agent, forwarding messages, replies, approval requests, and questions over a long-lived connection.

capabilities: Connects to Feishu/Lark through a WebSocket long connection
Forwards user messages to a locally running DeepSeek Harness session
Sends agent replies, approval requests, and questions back to Feishu conversations
Maintains per-user session mappings in local state
Uses Feishu application credentials and a local DSH API endpoint
